OPERATIONS
==========

POWER ON/OFF
------------

.. list-table::
   :header-rows: 0
   :widths: 20 40 40

   * - **On**
     - Press once
     -
   * - **Off**
     - Press and hold for 3s
     -

LCD DISPLAY ON/OFF
------------------

When you press the main POWER button or when charging the product, the LCD display is illuminated. When you press it again, the LCD display will be switched off.

.. list-table::
   :header-rows: 0
   :widths: 12 88

   * - **NOTE**
     -
       - When using with Jackery HomePower 2000 Plus, you can control the power status (on or off) of Jackery Battery Pack 2000 through the main POWER button of Jackery HomePower 2000 Plus.
       - The product will automatically shut down if it is not charged or no loads are connected for |DEFAULT_STANDBY_DURATION|.
